text:
REJECT
The patch changes behaviour: originally `isActions` was computed independently, so a `route` file or `pages/api` file starting with `"use server"` had `isActions == true`, but now `ClassifyNextFile` returns `RouteFile` or `ApiRoute` first, so `isActions = kind == NextKind.Actions` is false for those files and any later use of `isActions` in the loop behaves differently.
